title: DNS & DHCP Troubleshooting
subject: Networking Services
description: Practice enterprise incident tickets using the 4-step workflow: Triage, Diagnosis, Fix (GUI), and Change Note.

tickets.title: Domain join fails due to missing SRV records
tickets.summary: A new workstation can resolve the domain name but cannot locate a domain controller during domain join.

workflow.triage: Domain join fails with 'cannot locate a domain controller'.
workflow.diagnosis: Client cannot resolve required AD SRV records (e.g., _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs) because it is using the wrong DNS server or SRV records are missing.
workflow.fix: DNS Manager: verify SRV records in _msdcs zone. DHCP: ensure option 006 points to AD DNS only. Flush DNS cache and retry.

tickets.title: Split-brain zone blocks public subdomains
tickets.summary: Internal clients cannot resolve careers.example.com after an internal zone for example.com was created.

workflow.triage: Internal lookups return NXDOMAIN for public subdomains.
workflow.diagnosis: Internal DNS is authoritative for example.com but lacks records for public subdomains, so it returns negative answers instead of forwarding.
workflow.fix: Adjust split-brain design: add required records, delegate/stub/conditional forward as appropriate, or revise internal naming.

tickets.title: Scope exhaustion causes intermittent IP failures
tickets.summary: Warehouse devices intermittently fail to obtain an IP during peak hours.

workflow.triage: Clients show APIPA or long DHCP delays; scope utilization is high.
workflow.diagnosis: Scope is exhausted due to insufficient pool and/or long leases.
workflow.fix: DHCP Manager: check scope statistics, expand pool or add new subnet, shorten lease if appropriate.

tickets.title: Clients in new VLAN cannot reach DHCP
tickets.summary: A new subnet was added, but devices only get APIPA addresses.

workflow.triage: No leases issued for the new subnet; DHCP server sees no DISCOVER packets from that VLAN.
workflow.diagnosis: Router/L3 switch is missing DHCP relay (IP helper) for that VLAN.
workflow.fix: Configure DHCP relay on the gateway to forward to the DHCP server; ensure the matching scope exists and is active.
